{{Quote|Green scout to Watcher base.''"<br />"''Copy, this is Watcher base, over.''"<br />"''Contact the fleet at Bestine. Inform them we've engaged Grievous and require reinforcements.''"<br />"''Right away, sir.|Fil, to Niner|audio=RequireReinforcements-LoG.flac|<ref name="log" />}}
'''Niner''' was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Niner was part of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fil/Legends|Fil's]] [[Fil's Squad/Legends|squad]], who accompanied recently promoted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]] during a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|mission]] to the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to capture the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. Before the [[Squad/Legends|group]] entered a [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] belonging to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in search of Gunray, Fil paired Niner with the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Bel/Legends|Bel]] and ordered both to stay outside and guard the [[Cloning/Legends|clones']] [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. After Fil ordered Niner and Bel to contact the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] for more [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Troop/Legends|trooper]] reinforcements, the clones boarded the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to contact the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. However, one of Grievous's [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]] used a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] to destroy the Republic [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] both Niner and Bel.

==Biography==
{{Quote|General, your droid is tracking an incoming ship. It matches the description of General Grievous' fighter. It's headed our way.|Niner, to Fisto|audio=HeadedOurWay-LoG.flac|<ref name="log" />}}
[[File:Bel_Niner.png|thumb|left|200px|Bel and Niner stand guard over their shuttle]]
Niner was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]<ref name="log" /> who was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="databank" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Niner served under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fil/Legends|Fil]] during a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|mission]] to the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]]. The mission's objective was to capture [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]],<ref name="log" /> who had recently been [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|rescued]] from Republic captivity.<ref name="cod">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref>

Niner accompanied recently promoted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]], who was leading the mission with Fil. The [[Fil's Squad/Legends|squad]] waited for the arrival of Vebb's former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], before they entered a nearby [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] belonging to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], in pursuit of Gunray. Fil paired Niner with [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Bel/Legends|Bel]] and ordered both to stay behind and watch after their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]]. After Fisto's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R6-H5/Legends|R6-H5]], tracked Grievous's approaching [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']], Niner contacted Fisto, who was inside the castle, to alert the [[Squad/Legends|group]]. Eventually, Niner and Bel received a transmission from Fil inside the castle, telling both [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] to contact the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] near the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine]] for more clone trooper reinforcements. Unbeknownst to the clone troopers, one of Grievous's [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] had spotted them. As the clones entered the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to ready the shuttle's long-range transmitter to contact the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], the MagnaGuard used a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] to destroy the shuttle, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Niner and Bel.<ref name="log" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Niner-TCW.png|thumb|right|180px|Niner, ready for action]]
{{Quote|Better warm up the shuttle's long range transmitter.|Niner, to Bel|audio=WarmUpTransmitter-LoG.flac|<ref name="log" />}}
As a clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="log" /> Niner stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="databank" /> He wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] that sported [[Color/Legends|red]] markings and also used an integrated [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], which was attached to his right armor bracer.<ref name="log" />

==Behind the scenes==
Niner was first featured in "[[Lair of Grievous]]," the tenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[December 12]], [[2008]]. The character was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who provided the voice of all of the clone troopers in the series.<ref name="log guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode010.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lair of Grievous}}</ref>
